sources.note: Homepage describing EHR, Practice Management, Medical Billing, and Patient Engagement as four main solution areas. Mentions specialties including Family Medicine, Pediatrics, Dermatology, Internal Medicine.

ONC certification details for all four versions (12.0–12.4). Lists additional software (NewCrop, Updox, Unis, eCR FHIR Now App). Describes costs, e-prescribing via Surescripts, immunization registry submission, patient portal via Updox, CQMs, and electronic case reporting.

EHR product page. Describes clinical documentation, e-prescribing via NewCrop, customizable templates, advanced reporting, secure messaging, cloud or local deployment. States designed by a physician for small practices.

Practice Management page. Features: unpaid claims tracking, eligibility verification, integrated Secure Connect Clearinghouse, reporting, claims status. FAQ confirms PM and EHR are separate systems that share patient data. Claims 'over 2,000 practices.'

Medical billing/RCM services page. Describes outsourced billing services including claim scrubbing, denial management, payment posting, patient statement management. Targets 95% first-pass payment rate.

AC Patient Connect page. Features: online scheduling, SMS appointment reminders, digital patient intake forms, secure digital consents, telemedicine integration, secure patient portal, customizable alerts.
Specialty-specific EHR solutions landing page. Minimal content — states 'tailored EHR solutions for your specialty' but doesn't list specific specialties on the page itself.

2017 Constellation Software press release on Harris acquiring Amazing Charts. States nearly 4,000 medical practices and 20,000 clinicians/staff. Describes Amazing Charts as providing EHR, PM, and Medical Billing to primary care and specialty outpatient practices.

EMR Industry listing. Founded 2001 by family physician. Cites 6,300+ practices, 25,000+ users, 75+ new practices/month. Lists the Amazing Charts family as including Harris CareTracker, digiChart, Clinix, MEDfx, and Pulse under Harris Healthcare.

Harris CareTracker website. Separate product focused on billing companies and RCM operations. Offers EHR/EMR, practice management, and 600+ integrations. Confirms it's a distinct platform from Amazing Charts despite shared corporate parent.

Capterra reviews page (blocked by 403, data from web search). ~3.6/5 stars from 99 reviews. Praised for affordability and ease of use. Criticized for crashes, slow cloud version, inconsistent support.
G2 reviews page (blocked by 403, data from web search). 4.1/5 stars from 7 reviews. Users cite ease of use and affordability as strengths.
Software Advice reviews (data from web search). 3.6/5 stars from 99 reviews. Similar themes — affordable, easy to learn, but frustrations with updates and feature limitations.
SelectHub comparison of Amazing Charts vs Harris CareTracker. Confirms they are distinct products under the same parent company with different target markets.
